children: On September 10, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after 30 consecutive business days below that level. The company has 180 days, until March 9, 2027, to regain compliance (10 consecutive business days at or above $1.00), with a potential second 180-day period; trading continues on Nasdaq and the company plans to seek approval for a reverse stock split.
